spells.name: Soaring Slam
spells.description: Rammus hops into the air and slams down in an area, dealing magic damage and Slowing by % for seconds. If used during Powerball, enemies in the center take an additional magic damage and are Knocked Up for seconds. Rammus then creates aftershocks in the area over seconds, repeating the Slow. The range of this Ability is increased by Rammus's Move Speed.
